body: Desktop host = new app apps/desktop (Electron via electron-vite), reusing all packages/* viewers UNCHANGED through the existing host-agnostic ViewerProps contract — not a rewrite, a new host + new adapters. Adapter swaps vs chrome-ext: idbStorage -> libsql/Drizzle SQLite (main process, IPC bridge), fsaAssets -> real Node fs (absolute paths available, FSA path-hiding gone), content-script intercept -> native file dialog + OS file association + chokidar file-watch for live auto-reload. Library/recents/tabs/ui_prefs/settings/scroll-memory/task-index/link-index move from idb-keyval into the SQLite schema (Drizzle migrations). Electron removes 3 chrome-ext constraints: MV3 CSP (eval ok), FSA path hiding, manual refresh (now fs.watch). Drag-directory->project is simpler & better than chrome kind:fsa because a stable absolute path exists. v1 SCOPE = full file manager INCLUDING safe file ops (rename/move/delete-to-trash/new) AND in-app raw-source editing+save (pulls roadmap editor forward). Renderer security: contextIsolation on, nodeIntegration off, all fs/db access via preload-exposed IPC only. Deferred: multi-window, electron-updater/code-signing/notarization, library sync.
title: Electron desktop host: electron-vite + libsql/Drizzle, reuse packages/* via ViewerProps, full-manager v1
